post_edit.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path ../Shared/SharedKernel/SharedKernel.csproj) { dotnet build ../Shared/SharedKernel/SharedKernel.csproj } elseif (Test-Path src/Shared/SharedKernel/SharedKernel.csproj) { dotnet build src/Shared/SharedKernel/SharedKernel.csproj }"

post_edit.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "param([string]$file); if ($file -and (Test-Path $file)) { if (Select-String -Path $file -Pattern 'Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore') { Write-Error 'CRITICAL: Entity Framework Core is strictly prohibited in Socratic ecosystem. Use ScyllaDB!' } }"
post_edit.description: Enforce strict NoSQL rule: prevent introducing Entity Framework Core

post_edit.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host '[Localization Check] Remember to keep ResourceRu.resx, ResourceUz.resx, and ResourceEn.resx synchronized!'"

post_edit.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$p = (Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter 'Assets.csproj' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).DirectoryName; if ($p) { npm --prefix $p run generate:codegen }"
